mentions.name: Multi-platform ATProto (Bluesky) client
mentions.description: A work-in-progress multi-platform client for ATProto servers such as Bluesky, emphasizing a clean orthogonal UI, running on platforms the default client doesn't support, and better use of screen space on small devices. Download is available on request.
mentions.problem: The default Bluesky client doesn't run on all platforms and makes poor use of screen space on small devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a multi platform client for ATProto servers, like Bluesky. The emphasis is on a clean orthogonal UI, running on platforms the default client doesn't run on, and better use of screen space on small devices.

evidence.value: I'm working on a multi platform client for ATProto servers, like Bluesky. The emphasis is on a clean orthogonal UI, running on platforms the default client doesn't run on, and better use of screen space on small devices.
